nodes.label: H1: c000 (Ni 18.5, Co 8.8, Mo 4.7, Ti 0.71, Al 1.02) is a classic maraging composition and reaches about 2000 MPa yield after aging through…

evidence.text: agent-generated hypothesis: c000 (Ni 18.5, Co 8.8, Mo 4.7, Ti 0.71, Al 1.02) is a classic maraging composition and reaches about 2000 MPa yield after aging through Ni3(Ti,Mo) and Fe2Mo precipitation. c101 (Cr 17, Ni 7, Al 1.2, no Co/Mo/Ti) is a precipitation-hardening stainless composition and is grouped with it as a mid-range test. The ~2000 MPa figure is a group-level prediction.
evidence.assumption: Both alloys are solution-treated and peak-aged, with no retained austenite or overaging. The rec-0008 claim (>=2000 MPa) applies directly only to c000. c101 lacks Co, Mo and Ti, so it likely falls short, and the group prediction is an upper-end estimate for it.

nodes.label: H2: c299 (Co 19.5, Cr 13.4, Mo 3.0, W 2.35), c008 (Mo 9.67, Co 4.9, C 0.38) and c049 (W 9.18, Co 5.0, C 0.36) are high-Co/Mo/W compositions…

evidence.text: agent-generated hypothesis: c299 (Co 19.5, Cr 13.4, Mo 3.0, W 2.35), c008 (Mo 9.67, Co 4.9, C 0.38) and c049 (W 9.18, Co 5.0, C 0.36) are high-Co/Mo/W compositions with no Ni. Co lowers Mo/W solubility and promotes fine carbide or intermetallic precipitation, so they are predicted to reach about 2300 MPa yield.
evidence.assumption: Strength rises with Co, Mo and W through secondary-hardening precipitation, with no embrittlement from coarse carbides or intermetallics. These are Cr/C secondary-hardening steels rather than Ni-bearing maraging steels, so the rec-0008 ranges (Ni 13-18%, Co 8-15%, Mo 3-10%, Ti) are only loosely applicable and the prediction is an extrapolation.

nodes.label: H3: Revised after H1 and H2 were refuted (c000 maraging measured 1309 MPa vs 2000 predicted; c299 tool steel measured 1123 MPa vs 2300 pred…

evidence.text: agent-generated hypothesis: Revised after H1 and H2 were refuted (c000 maraging measured 1309 MPa vs 2000 predicted; c299 tool steel measured 1123 MPa vs 2300 predicted). c154 (Cr 12.3, Co 14.8, W 8.0), c173 (Cr 17.5, Co 11.8, Si 2.0, Ni 2.1) and c150 (Cr 17.5, Ni 4.4, Mn 2.8, Al 0.9) are Cr-rich Co/W or Ni-bearing steels with no maraging Ni-Mo-Ti chemistry. They are predicted to land near the measured band, about 1200 MPa yield, not the >=2000 MPa literature figure.
evidence.assumption: Real yield in this dataset sits well below the literature peak-aged claims. The two measurements (1309 and 1123 MPa) are taken as the anchor, and the prediction is their rough midpoint, about 1200 MPa. Candidates are assumed to be in the processing condition of the dataset (not necessarily peak-aged), and the 2000+ MPa values in rec-0008 are treated as not transferable. Two data points are a thin basis, and the ±300 MPa uncertainty is large.
